note: The thicket's people are tools/worlds/homelands.json's (Misty Thicket): Elder Brightwing under the tall pines gives the first two, Huntress Thistledown a few steps north of her the three hunts; Spinner Gossamer, a few steps south-east, is the outfitter; Coachman Fernwick keeps the stable on open ground farther south-east (his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes); the bramble rats (the brambles to the south-west), the thicket beetles (the low ground to the east) and the hornet Redsting (alone, far to the south) are placed for these quests. Levels 7-20 (2026-11-11): Thistledown gives L7-L15, Brightwing the L20 path; objectives on the Homelands' shared ground, the Goldfeather Eyrie (Fernwick's coach): wand whiskers, frost silk, the grey cat Old Frostjaw, a shard for Scout Feyla, her eyes lent.

L1.name: A Spark's Dewdrop Ring
offer: Oh! A new little spark, and your wings hardly dry. Welcome, welcome. Now, every pixie of the thicket wears a dewdrop ring, so the mist knows us and lets us through.
Spinner Gossamer catches the dew for them at first light. She is a few wingbeats south-east of here.
Will you fetch your ring and show it to me?
L1.declined: As you like, little spark. The dew comes every morning.
L1.started: Off you flit! South-east, just past the pines.

piece.name: dewdrop ring
piece.description: A ring of spider silk holding one drop of morning dew that never dries. Every pixie of the Misty Thicket wears one.

fetch.journal: Ask Spinner Gossamer, a few steps south-east of Elder Brightwing, for a dewdrop ring.
fetch.says: A new spark! Hold out a finger. One twist of silk, one drop of first dew. There! It will never dry. No charge, the dew is free.

show.journal: Show the dewdrop ring to Elder Brightwing.
show.says: How it shines! Now the mist will part for you, little spark, as it does for all of us.

L2.name: Bound to the Thicket
offer: The world beyond the mist is full of nets and jars, little spark. Have Spiritmaster Glimmerdew bind your spirit to the thicket, so that you wake here if you fall.
Then give your name to Coachman Fernwick for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands, for those their stables know.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
L2.declined: Then fly high, and keep away from jars.
L2.started: Glimmerdew is off to the west, among the far pines. Fernwick waits to the south-east, past Gossamer.

bind.journal: Have Spiritmaster Glimmerdew, among the pines to the west, bind your spirit to the thicket.
bind.says: Done, and gently. Should you fall, the mist will carry you back to me. Now flit along to Coachman Fernwick.

ledger.journal: Give your name to Coachman Fernwick, south-east of the elder, for his ledger.
ledger.says: In the ledger you go, small as you are! My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for travelers whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

says: Lovely. Now the thicket can always find you, and you it.
Fernwick's coach will carry you to Freeport if its ledger knows you, but the way to the elves is earned. Huntress Thistledown, just north of me, has work for you.

L3.name: Rats in the Brambles
offer: The new spark! Good. The bramble rats are gnawing the berry canes to the south-west again, and a rat is a great beast to a pixie. Time you learned that it bleeds.
Bring me three of their tails, and I will teach you something worth the scratches.
Will you hunt them?
L3.declined: Then no berries this year, and you may tell the elder why.
L3.started: Three tails. South-west, where the brambles grow thick. Go for the eyes.

drop.name: bramble rat tail
drop.description: The tail of a bramble rat from the brambles south-west of the pines.

hunt.journal: Take three bramble rat tails from the bramble rats in the brambles south-west of the pines.

give.journal: Bring three bramble rat tails to Huntress Thistledown.
give.says: Three tails, each one longer than you are! Well flown. Now watch my hands, little spark, and learn this.

L4.name: A Spark's Arms
offer: The elves will not send you out with only your sparkle. I will make you proper gear, if you bring me what I need.
Spinner Gossamer has a leather strip and a shaft put by for me. Then take a shell from the thicket beetles on the low ground to the east.
Will you bring me all three?
L4.declined: Then sparkle hard, and hope it is enough.
L4.started: Leather and a shaft from Gossamer, a shell from the beetles. Quick as you can!

materials.journal: Ask Spinner Gossamer for the leather strip and the wooden shaft.
materials.says: For Thistledown? Here: a strip of leather and a shaft, both far too big for either of us. Tell her to mind the canes.

drop.name: thicket beetle shell
drop.description: The glossy shell of a thicket beetle from the low ground east of the pines.

hunt.journal: Take a thicket beetle shell from the thicket beetles on the low ground east of the pines.

give.journal: Bring the leather strip, the wooden shaft and the thicket beetle shell to Huntress Thistledown.
give.says: All three! A pinch of dust, a twist... there. It will grow to fit your hand. It is yours, little spark.

L5.name: Redsting
offer: One hunt more before the elves have you. A great red hornet we call Redsting hunts the woods far to the south. She has carried off two of our scouts, wings and all.
She is faster than you and she knows it, so strike first and do not stop. Bring me her stinger, and I will teach you the last thing I have for a spark.
Will you hunt Redsting?
L5.declined: She will not grow slower while you wait.
L5.started: South, a long flight through the trees. Listen for the buzzing.

drop.name: Redsting's stinger
drop.description: The barbed red stinger of the hornet Redsting, as long as a pixie's arm.

hunt.journal: Take Redsting's stinger from the hornet Redsting in the woods far south of the pines.

give.journal: Bring Redsting's stinger to Huntress Thistledown.
says: Redsting's own stinger! The scouts will fly south again. You are a little spark no longer. Well, a little one still.
Learn this, and see Gatekeeper Thistlewhirl to the east when you are ready for the elves.

flight.name: The Elves' Wood
offer: The elves of Tethelin and the Fayspires have always welcomed our kind, and they will teach you as their own. Thistledown says you are ready.
You have earned the flight, little spark. I will set you down among your own guild in the elves' wood, and your spirit will rest there.
Shall I send you to the elves?
flight.declined: The elves are patient. They live a long time.
flight.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Thistlewhirl when you are ready to go to the elves.

L7.name: Whiskers and Fur
offer: Little spark, you have grown! Well, a little. The homes keep a hunters' outpost on the snow under the Goldfeather Eyrie, and pixies hunt there too.
Ride Fernwick's coach there. Drift rat whiskers make the best wand cores, and a badger pelt makes a fine warm nest. Find both east of the outpost.
Will you hunt the Eyrie's snow?
L7.declined: The snow will wait. It is good at that.
L7.started: Two whiskers and a pelt. Keep your wings dry, they freeze!

drop.name: drift rat whisker
drop.description: A stiff white whisker from a drift rat of the Goldfeather Eyrie's snow.

hunt.journal: Take two drift rat whiskers from the drift rats east of the Eyrie outpost.

drop.name: snowfield badger pelt
drop.description: The thick pelt of a snowfield badger of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

hunt.journal: Take a snowfield badger pelt from the badgers on the snow east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the drift rat whiskers and the badger pelt to Huntress Thistledown.
give.says: Whiskers for wands, and a nest for winter! You hunt like a pixie twice your size. Now watch my hands, and learn this.

L10.name: Silk for a Spark
offer: Your arms are too small for you now, little spark. I will make you new ones, light as a wing and sharp as a sting.
Spinner Gossamer has a shaft for me. Then bring me two skeins of silk from the rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost. Frost silk holds a spell.
Will you bring me the shaft and the silk?
L10.declined: Then your old arms will have to do.
L10.started: Gossamer first, then the spiders. Do not get stuck in their webs!

materials.journal: Ask Spinner Gossamer for the shaft Huntress Thistledown put by.
materials.says: Thistledown's shaft, yes, yes. Here! I polished it with morning dew. It is very shiny now.

drop.name: rime spider silk
drop.description: A skein of frosted silk from a rime spider of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

hunt.journal: Take two skeins of silk from the rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the wooden shaft and the rime spider silk to Huntress Thistledown.
give.says: Frost silk! A pinch of dust, a twist, a wink... there. It is yours, little spark, and it will not freeze in your hand.

L13.name: The Grey Cat
offer: There is a great grey cat on the slopes north-east of the Eyrie outpost. Old Frostjaw, they call him. He has eaten three of their hunters, and he looks up at us.
A cat is a terrible beast to a pixie. That is why you must hunt him: so you will never fear one again. Take friends from the other homes.
Will you hunt Old Frostjaw?
L13.declined: Then stay off the slopes, little spark.
L13.started: Stay above him if you can. And take friends!

hunt.journal: Kill Old Frostjaw on the slopes north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

back.says: The grey cat is gone, and here you are, wings and all! No cat will frighten you now. Learn this.

L15.name: A Shard for the Scout
offer: Scout Feyla of the Eyrie watches the river and sees everything, a little like us. She has sent word: something walks in the ice caves north-east of the outpost.
The Rimeheart, she calls it. Break it, take her a shard so she can see it is done, and come back to me.
Will you face the Rimeheart?
L15.declined: Then the scout keeps watching, and the caves grow colder.
L15.started: Do not go into those caves alone, little spark. Not even a little bit alone.

drop.name: shard of the Rimeheart
drop.description: A shard of blue ice that never melts, broken from the Rimeheart.

hunt.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

carry.journal: Bring the shard of the Rimeheart to Scout Feyla on the river, north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
carry.says: A pixie broke the Rimeheart? I watched the caves go quiet and wondered. Tell Thistledown the river thanks the thicket.

back.says: Feyla's word came by the coach, and it was very nice word. You are the bravest spark in the thicket. Learn this.

L20.name: Feyla's Eyes
offer: Thistledown says you hunt grey cats and ice now! My little spark. The Eyrie's scout has asked for the sharpest eyes in the Homelands, and a pixie's are.
Go to Scout Feyla on the river, north-east of the Eyrie outpost, and help her watch. When it is done, come home, and you will choose your path.
Will you lend the scout your eyes?
L20.declined: Then the scout watches alone a little longer.
L20.started: Fernwick's coach will take you. Fly well, and come home!

road.journal: Find Scout Feyla on the frozen river, north-east of the Eyrie outpost.
road.says: Brightwing's spark! Good. The Goldfeather raiders carry war-talons. Take two, and show them to Warden Halvek so he can send them home.

drop.name: Goldfeather war-talon
drop.description: A war-talon of the Goldfeather aviaks, bound in gold thread.

hunt.journal: Take two war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.

handin.journal: Bring the two war-talons to Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
handin.says: Feyla's pixie, with two talons? The raiders will know the river is watched. Fly home, little one. Your elder is waiting.

final.journal: Return to Elder Brightwing in the thicket.
final.says: There you are! The whole thicket has heard. You flew out a spark and came home a light. Now, one thing more: choose your path.
